   species = Column(String, nullable=False, check_constraint=\"species IN ('dog', 'cat', 'other')\")\n    breed = Column(String)\n    birth_date = Column(Date)\n    age_years = Column(Integer)\n    temperament = Column(String, check_constraint=\"temperament IN ('calm', 'gentle', 'energetic', 'aggressive', 'shy', 'playful')\")\n    status = Column(String, nullable=False, check_constraint=\"status       "path": "routers/group_001.py",
      "content": "from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import Session\nfrom sqlalchemy import and_, func\nfrom datetime import datetime, timedelta\n\nfrom database import get_db\nfrom models import Animal\nfrom schemas import AnimalOut, SearchDogsRequest\n\nrouter = APIRouter(tags=[\"Animals\"])\n\n\n@router.get(\n    \"/api/animals/search\",\n    operation_id=\"search_dogs_stray_medical\",\n    response_model=list[AnimalOut]\n)\nasync def search_dogs_stray_medical(\n    species: str = Query(..., description=\"The species of the animal, must be 'dog'\", example=\"dog\"),\n    min_age: int = Query(..., description=\"Minimum age of the animal in years\", example=7),\n    temperaments: list[str] = Query(..., description=\"List of acceptable temperaments\", example=[\"calm\", \"gentle\"]),\n    statuses: list[str] = Query(..., description=\"List of acceptable statuses\", example=[\"stray_hold\", \"medical_treatment\"]),\n    max_intake_days_ago: int = Query(..., description=\"Maximum number of days since intake\", example=30),\n    db: Session = Depends(get_db)\n):\n    # Calculate the cutoff date\n    cutoff_date = datetime.utcnow().date() - timedelta(days=max_intake_days_ago)\n\n    # Build the query\n    stmt = db.query(Animal).filter(\n        and_(\n            Animal.species == species,\n            Animal.age_years >= min_age,\n            Animal.temperament.in_(temperaments),\n            Animal.status.in_(statuses),\n            Animal.intake_date <= cutoff_date\n        )\n    )\n\n    results = stmt.all()\n\n    # Convert to Pydantic models\n    return [AnimalOut.model_validate(animal) for animal in results]"
